title: The cheapest new cars to own in America are THESE retro-styled EVs
content:
A study of 50 new cars found that the compact but stylish Fiat 500e was America’s cheapest car to own and drive, beating out the Honda Civic Hybrid by nearly $1,300 per year.
And the second most affordable EV to own? It’s also from Stellantis.
A recent study Self.Inc looked at the total cost of ownership (TCO) of 50 new cars, the little Fiat 500e showed that the Italians really do know a thing or two about building affordable cars easily beating the next-most-affordable option, the Honda Civic Hybrid, with average annual costs of just $3,557 compared to $4,833 for the Civic.
Self says its study takes into account the average costs for four factors: annual fuel or energy costs, annual maintenance costs, annual insurance costs, and annual fees and taxes – the average of the 50? A stout $6,913 per year (up $451 from Self‘s last such study from 2024). Interestingly, the study found that the hybrid cars it tested were the most affordable to own at $5,734 per year, compared to $6,189 battery electrics and $7,025 for ICE-powered vehicles.
And, if that surprises you, wait until you read this next bit …
Charged up at number 2
The Fiat 500e may not have been too huge of a surprise, given its low entry price, small size, and general efficiency, but if anything is going to convince you that All Lists Are Weird (© Jo Borrás, 2026), it’s this little nugget: the second most affordable EV to own on Self‘s list is the also by Stellantis: the also retro-styled Dodge Freakin’ Charger Daytona.
The study found that the Dodge Charger EV cost “just” $911 for a year’s worth of energy, $1,364 in annual maintenance (almost all of that tires), $1,907 in insurance, and $1,117 for annual taxes and fees for a total annual cost of operation of $5,298 – about $200 less than a Tesla Model 3 or a Hyundai IONIQ 6, and about $200 less than the Honda Accord.
On the opposite end of the spectrum, the Porsche 911 and Audi RS7 topped the list with annual running costs well over $10,000, while the Lucid Air came in as the most expensive EV to own, at $10,049 per year.

title: 国轩高科/远东股份等5家储能企业发布2026年上半年业绩
content:
集邦光储观察获悉，近期，国轩高科、远东股份、思格新能源、艾罗能源、科力远等储能企业相继发布2026年上半年业绩情况，多家企业储能业务实现较快增长。

目前，国轩高科已构建起涵盖网源侧、电网侧、工商业、户用及移动储能的全链条产品体系。
报告期内，公司持续深耕储能系统核心技术攻关，不断丰富多化学体系产品矩阵，正式发布了“钠晨”钠离子电池以及“干元智储2.0”储能系统等多款重磅新产品。

8月21日，远东股份披露2026年半年度报告。上半年，公司实现营业收入129.92亿元，同比增长0.12%；归母净利润2.05亿元，同比增长43.13%；扣非净利润1.99亿元，同比增长73.35%。
其中，储能业务增长较为明显。报告期内，储能业务实现收入4.88亿元，同比增长394.55%，获超千万订单22.31亿元，同比增长421.69%。
项目方面，上半年公司落地河北武强200MW/800MWh独立储能电站、新疆立诺200MW/800MWh构网型独立储能项目，以及拉脱维亚5MW/10MWh储能项目。同时，公司继续拓展海外市场，在南欧市场基础上，进一步布局美国算力储能项目，并稳步拓展欧美、中东等区域。
8月24日晚，思格新能源披露2026年半年度业绩。上半年，公司实现营业收入98.74亿元，同比增长261.2%；期内利润24.28亿元，同比增长201%；经调整净利润24.85亿元，同比增长135.8%。
其中，光储系列产品仍是其主要收入来源，2026年上半年该项业务实现收入92.96亿元，同比增长267.1%，占公司总收入的94.2%。公司表示，收入增长主要来自业务规模扩大及产品销量增加。同时，受原材料成本上升以及加大渠道激励力度影响，该业务毛利率由52.4%降至40.7%。
目前，思格新能源产品覆盖户用、工商及地面电站等应用场景，包括SigenStor、SigenStack及SigenTerra等光储产品。报告期内，公司南通智能能源中心启动运营，并计划根据市场需求、产品结构及产能爬坡情况提升生产和交付能力。
海外市场方面，公司表示将继续深化欧洲市场，同时扩大亚太、非洲及北美市场业务，并探索拉丁美洲、中东及中亚等市场。
艾罗能源2026年上半年实现营业收入31.54亿元，同比增长74.59%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润亏损3513.21万元，同比下降124.78%；归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润亏损4840.08万元，同比减少146.14%。
在储能与逆变器业务方面，公司依托“欧洲+新兴市场”双向发力实现营收规模的显着扩张。欧洲市场收入同比增长约59.49%，占总营收比重为59.61%；同时，受当地补贴等储能政策驱动，澳大利亚、越南、菲律宾等新兴市场销售收入分别增长598%、1780%和865%。
尽管储能相关产品销量大幅增长，但受新兴市场价格相对较低、上游原材料涨价及电池产品出口退税率下调等叠加影响，公司当期毛利率降至27.95%，较上年同期减少5.62%。此外，海外业务占比超98%导致的大额汇兑损失也进一步拖累了短期盈利。
下半年，艾罗能源将持续优化产品结构，提升大型储能等新产品的市场占有率，并全面推行精益化管理以推动生产降本增效。
8月24日晚间，科力远披露2026年半年报。上半年，公司实现营业收入24.79亿元，同比增长36.11%；归母净利润5650.36万元，同比增长10.32%；扣非净利润4957.17万元，同比增长4.82%。
公司业绩增长主要源自储能和锂电材料。其中，储能产品实现收入约6.48亿元，较上年同期约1.15亿元增长463.5%，占公司营收比重升至约26%。
制造端，科力远保定储能智能制造产业基地上半年实现储能系统销售1.23GWh，已具备5MWh、6.25MWh储能柜集成能力，远期规划年产能10GWh。与此同时，公司持续通过储能产业基金参与项目投资建设，增强项目获取、投资及运营能力。
项目方面，截至6月底，科力远已推动井陉、望都、谷山梁、诸城、馆陶、罗庄6座独立储能电站并网投运，总装机规模900MW/2600MWh。
目前，科力远已在多个地区储备超过10GWh储能电站项目，下半年计划通过产业基金或其他合作方式投资约4GWh。已投运项目、新增项目和项目储备形成梯次衔接，为后续设备交付和运营资产扩容提供了项目基础。

title: 超4.8GWh，华为、易事特等3企披露储能订单新进展
content:
集邦光储观察获悉，近期，多家储能企业传来订单新动态，华为数字能源、易事特、常德昆宇接连披露储能订单最新进展，包含大型储能项目推进、并网落地，及钠离子电池订单等。
华为推进埃及4GWh储能项目进展
8月23日，据外媒“DAILY NEWS”报道，埃及电力与可再生能源部与华为举行会议，审查一项本地制造电池储能系统项目的进展，项目总装机容量4GWh。
该项目涵盖储能电站建设与本地化制造布局，计划建设总装机容量为4GWh的多座独立的BESS电站。本次项目将以埃镑计价落地实施，并同步推进储能电池本地化生产布局。
易事特供货800MWh独立储能项目
8月24日，易事特储能宣布，位于新疆和田地区民丰县的立新能源民丰200MW/800MWh独立储能项目，近期已完成反送电并具备并网送电条件。
易事特为该项目提供构网型6.7MW/26.8MWh集中式液冷储能系统。易事特构网型储能系统支持真构网功能，系统支持300%10s有功、无功、视在全过载能力，并具备并网、离网、黑启动等多种运行模式。
常德昆宇获30MWh钠电储能订单
据常德经开区报道，近期，常德昆宇新能源科技有限公司一批由墨西哥客户定制的30MWh储能项目电池，正在加紧生产，预计10月底前完成交付。
据悉，该笔订单金额达3500万元。常德昆宇表示，目前，公司的钠离子产品已销往德国、挪威、荷兰、新加坡等地。预计在2027年年底前，公司的钠离子电池所占销售额比例，将从目前的5%提升到30%以上。
此外，常德昆宇表示，随着全球AI技术发展，人工智能数据中心（AIDC）对储能装置的安全性、循环寿命和倍率性能提出更高要求，而钠离子电池在上述方面具备相对优势，公司将结合AIDC扩张趋势，加快相关产品的推广应用。

title: 超43GWh，亿纬锂能等5企储能项目签约、开工、投产
content:
集邦光储观察获悉，近期，亿纬锂能、紫创光科、金麟汇科、金鑫新能、星空钠电等多家企业接连传来项目签约、开工、投产等动态，覆盖储能电池、光伏逆变器及光储产业配套设备、圆柱锂电池、钠离子电芯等领域。
亿纬锂能马来西亚储能电池工厂开工
据中建集团消息，8月24日，近日，马来西亚亿纬锂能三期工厂项目开工。项目位于马来西亚居林东鑫工业园，总建筑面积约20万平方米，由中建三局承建。
据悉，该项目规划年产38GWh储能电池，主要建设电芯厂、化成车间、锂锰工厂、锂亚工厂和动力站、变电站、消防中心等配套用房。项目建成后，将扩充海外储能产能，完善亿纬全球化产业布局。
一光伏逆变器/光储配套项目即将投产
8月25日，据“眉山发布”消息，近日，四川丹棱经开区紫创光科(眉山)智慧能源科技有限公司光伏逆变器及光储产业配套设备智能产线项目即将投产。
据悉，光伏逆变器及光储产业配套设备智能产线项目总投资1亿元，目前已完成厂房修建、设备进场调试等关键工作，各项筹备工作有序收尾，预计今年9月正式投产，投产后可实现规模化量产。
3GWh圆柱锂离子电池项目开工
8月21日，新疆金麟汇科能源科技有限公司年产3GWh圆柱型锂离子电池项目在兵团第十一师（建工师）新型建材经济技术开发区正式开工。
据悉，项目一期总投资3.6亿元。三元体系规划产能2GWh，磷酸铁锂体系规划产能1GWh，产品矩阵覆盖18650、21700及32140三种主流圆柱规格。其中，磷酸铁锂系列聚焦源网侧储能、户用及工商业户外电源等高安全、长循环需求领域。
2.2GWh钠离子电芯项目二期即将投产
据“陇东报”消息，日前，甘肃省庆阳市正宁县石墨烯钠离子电芯项目二期首批生产设备已全部进场到位，整体工程预计9月建成投产。
该由金鑫新能投资、中钠储能新能源科技（甘肃）有限公司具体实施。据悉，该项目总投资10亿元，于2023年3月开工建设，分两期有序推进。
一期工程投资1.8亿元，建设年产3GWh储能生产线、1GWh锂电池生产线，已于2024年顺利竣工投产。二期工程计划总投资8.2亿元，新建2.2GWh石墨烯钠离子电芯生产线，目前已进入施工攻坚关键阶段。
星空钠电钠电池项目落地
据“星空钠电”消息，近日，星空钠电与浙江湖州南浔经济开发区举行钠离子电池智能工厂项目签约仪式。
资料显示，星空钠电成立于2018年1月24日，总部位于辽宁省鞍山市高新区，是一家高新技术企业，隶属辽宁宏成集团，专注于钠离子电池材料研发、储能技术开发及电池生产。

title: Romanian Senate backs €120/MWh fines for missing 42% green hydrogen targets

Bookmark
Romanian industrial companies could face fines equivalent to about €120 for every megawatt-hour by which they fall short of a 42% green hydrogen target from 2030, under new legislation backed by the country’s Senate.
The bill implementing industrial mandates under the EU’s Renewable Energy Directive III (RED III) will require industrial hydrogen consumers to ensure that at least
42% of hydrogen used
for energy and non-energy purposes comes from renewable fuels of non-biological origin (RFNBOs) from 2030.
Companies that fail to meet the quota would be fined 0.17 lei ($0.038) for every megajoule of shortfall – around 612 lei/MWh or €120/MWh.
The penalty would be capped at 5% of a company’s net turnover in the previous financial year. Companies without turnover in the preceding year would face a maximum fine of 10m lei ($2.2m).
The eventual 2030 penalty is also likely to be higher nominally, with the legislation requiring the per-megajoule rate and fine limits to be adjusted annually for inflation from January 2028.
However, simply paying the fine would not allow companies to wipe out their green hydrogen deficit. The legislation would add any shortfall to the company’s obligation for the following year, although the same deficit could not be fined twice for the same compliance period.
It applies to industrial uses of hydrogen such as chemicals, semiconductors, and metallurgy. Refining of transport fuels and biofuels is excluded as they are covered by RED III’s separate transport requirements.
Alongside the penalties, the bill also includes provisions for the Romanian government to introduce two-way contracts for difference or equivalent support schemes for green hydrogen production, though details remain slim.
With the quota rising to 60% from 2035, Romania is among the
first EU countries
to put a detailed enforcement regime behind RED III’s industrial hydrogen targets.
Consumers would be able to meet the target through domestic purchases, imports, their own production or transfers within an integrated company, provided the hydrogen is certified with valid documentation using an independently audited mass-balance system.
The RED III industrial targets have proved the most difficult for member states to transpose amid concerns that the mandates could erode the competitiveness of key sectors.
Major hydrogen-backing countries like Spain and Germany so far have only implemented the transport targets.

title: More EV Owners Can Now Get Paid To Power California’s Grid
content:
More EV Owners Can Now Get Paid To Power California’s Grid
The new Chevy Bolt EV and Kia EV9 are among a bunch of new EVs capable of vehicle-to-grid power sharing.
- The West Coast's largest utility is expanding its vehicle-to-everything bidirectional charging program.
- Owners of many new all-electric models can now participate, including those who own the Volvo EX90 and the Chevy Bolt.
- PG&E's initiative allows EV drivers to lower their energy bills and support the grid.
More electric vehicle owners in California can now use their cars’ batteries to share electricity with the grid and get paid for doing it.
Pacific Gas & Electric said Monday that it is expanding its vehicle-to-everything (V2X) program to include EVs from Nissan, Volvo, Polestar and Kia, along with more General Motors models like the Chevy Bolt.
EVs are essentially giant power banks on wheels. They can not only swallow huge amounts of electricity at charging stations, but many can also send that stored energy back to power appliances, homes, and even the electric grid. That capability could be a game-changer at scale, helping reduce strain on the grid during periods of high demand while giving EV owners another source of backup power during outages and natural disasters.
Volvo EX90 charging from a Level 2 home charger.
PG&E said it is partnering with software company Bidirectional Energy, which operates a platform that connects EVs to homes and the grid and allows customers to earn money by sharing power. The utility is also teaming up with renewable energy company PowerFlex to expand V2X adoption across California.
Several GM EVs were already compatible with the program, including the Chevrolet Silverado EV and Equinox EV.
"This expansion is all about choice," David Almeida, the director of clean energy transportation at PG&E said in a statement. "By broadening the mix of eligible vehicles and chargers, we're helping our customers access this valuable technology, while also offering them a way to turn their EV into a home backup and a grid asset."
PG&E said the expanded program now includes the new Chevy Bolt EV, Cadillac Celestiq, Escalade IQL, Nissan Leaf (previous gen), Volvo EX90, Polestar 3, and Kia EV9 and EV6. The Ford F-150 Lightning and Tesla Cybertruck were already compatible with the program.
Residential customers can receive incentives of up to $2,500 for installation, with that amount rising to $3,000 for customers in disadvantaged communities. There’s also a separate $1,500 Early Adopter incentive for the first 250 customers.
For businesses, the incentive is worth up to $4,500, increasing to $5,000 for those in disadvantaged communities. The enrollment period runs through June 2027.
Of course, V2X isn’t quite as simple as plugging an EV into the wall and telling it to start making money. You need specialized hardware to send electricity from the vehicle back to your home or the grid.
A Tesla Cybertruck, for example, can send power to the grid using Tesla’s Universal Wall Connector home Level 2 charger combined with its Powershare Gateway system. GM EVs can use the company’s PowerShift charger, while the Kia EV9 and EV6 can send power to the grid using Wallbox Quasar 2 chargers. PG&E has a full list of compatible vehicles and chargers.
So how much can customers actually earn by sending electricity back to the grid?
One of the biggest advantages of this kind of arrangement is the ability to charge an EV when electricity is cheap, typically overnight, and then send power back to the grid when electricity prices are higher during peak daytime hours. Customers may not necessarily see a big difference in their bank account right away, but they can reduce how much electricity they need to buy from the grid, lowering their home energy bill in the process.
If the value of the electricity exported from the EV exceeds the cost of the energy being consumed by the home, that’s when the savings can turn into actual earnings.
PG&E’s hourly electricity rates change every day and are influenced by factors including transmission costs, grid demand, time of day and weather conditions. According to the utility's Home Flex pricing chart, customers could earn anywhere from 5 cents to 50 cents per kilowatt-hour on August 23.
Right now, V2X still involves a somewhat messy combination of software platforms, compatible vehicles, and specialized chargers. And it's still limited to pilot programs around the country such as PG&E's, which as been running for a couple of years. So the expansion is a welcome step toward making bidirectional charging more useful to a much larger pool of EV owners.

title: Polestar Still Has No Idea Why The U.S. Kicked It Out
content:
Polestar Still Has No Idea Why The U.S. Kicked It Out
The automaker was stripped off its authorization to sell cars in the U.S. model year 2027 onward.
- Polestar said the Department of Commerce has not yet explained its ban on selling cars in the U.S.
- It is arguing that Volvo was granted authorization to sell an EV with an identical software stack.
- The automaker has not appealed the Trump administration's decision.
Polestar has yet to get an explanation from the U.S. Department of Commerce for its decision to effectively force the automaker out of the American car market. The government denied the automaker, which is owned by China’s Geely Group, authorization to sell cars in the U.S. for model year 2027 onward. Its corporate cousin, Volvo, was granted a special authorization to continue selling its cars in the U.S.
In a letter sent to dealers and viewed by The Wall Street Journal (paywall), Polestar said it has yet to hear back from the Trump administration on why it must stop selling EVs in America. The automaker argued that its Polestar 3 electric SUV is mechanically identical to the Volvo EX90, and that both are assembled on the same production line at the Volvo Cars plant in Ridgeville, South Carolina.
Gallery: Polestar 3
At the core of all this is the Connected Vehicle rule, which restricts vehicles linked to hardware or software from foreign adversaries such as China and Russia from being sold in the U.S. The rule was finalized by the Biden administration and argues that vehicles connected to Chinese technology, including telematics and advanced driver assistance systems, could pose a national security risk or potentially be used to spy on Americans.
“In essence, we are currently focusing on getting the attention of (the Commerce Department) to obtain the requested information and to understand the underlying basis for the denial,” Peter Wexler, Polestar’s U.S. head of government affairs, said in the letter viewed by The WSJ. He added that the Volvo EX90 was “a car that is essentially the same as the Polestar 3 and that uses the same software stack.”
The saga took a bizarre twist earlier this month when a New Jersey Polestar dealer filed a lawsuit against the Swedish automaker, claiming that it was planning its U.S. exit for two years and used the government ruling as a cover up. The dealership, Prestige Imports, said Polestar violated New Jersey’s Franchise Practices Act, which generally prohibits automakers from terminating a franchise without at least 60 days advance written notice and good cause.
Sweden's Minister for Foreign Trade Benjamin Dousa said that he worked very closely with Volvo to make sure it met the Connected Vehicle Rule requirements to continue selling cars in the U.S., but Polestar didn't ask for the same help, per Automotive News.
All told, Polestar did not appeal the U.S. government’s ban and instead said it would double down on the European market, which accounts for 80% of its global sales.
That said, if you’re looking for a bargain EV, you may still want to consider a Polestar. The automaker is offering a whopping $25,000 discount on the Polestar 4 coupe and Polestar 3 SUV as it prepares to wind down its U.S. operations. It’s a rather unusual way to end a chapter in the American market. Sell the cars for less while waiting for the government to explain why you can’t sell them at all.

title: Tesla's FSD Lite Seems To Have A Hard Time Seeing Trees And Logs
content:
Tesla's FSD Lite Seems To Have A Hard Time Seeing Trees And Logs
Two different users on X posted videos of their cars failing to see downed trees in the middle of the road.
- On X, two drivers posted videos of FSD Lite v14.1 not stopping for objects in the road, namely fallen trees and wooden logs.
- FSD Lite is designed to run on Tesla's Hardware 3, which has significantly less computing power compared to Hardware 4 used in later cars.
- FSD Lite was introduced this June.
As Tesla tries to scale up its fleet of self-driving cars and roll out the steering wheel-free Cybercab, Full Self-Driving (Supervised) continues to stumble in serious ways.
One video posted on X on August 21 shows a user named Baldersonmichae using FSD on the road at night. Ahead of him, there’s a fallen tree in the middle of the road, but the car doesn’t seem to notice the large mess of branches and leaves and does not slow down. The driver intervenes and manually stops the car to avoid a collision.
This apparently wasn’t a one-off, either. The driver says he tried the same exact spot three more times, all with the same result. Further down in the comments, another Tesla owner posted a video that purports to show his FSD-equipped car hitting a big log at 32 mph without stopping.
Both drivers say they were running what’s known as FSD v14.1 Lite. This new version of the software is specifically designed to run on cars that use Tesla’s Hardware 3 system. Hardware 3 was introduced in 2019 and doesn’t offer the same performance as the Hardware 4 setup of computers and cameras that landed in cars post-2023. The cameras are lower-resolution 1.2 megapixel ones (compared to the 5 megapixel ones on the updated version). Also, notably, the system has significantly less RAM, only 8 GB worth, compared to the 16 GB per chip in Hardware 4.
Earlier this year, Tesla CEO Elon Musk laid out limitations of Hardware 3, saying on an earnings call that the system won't be able to handle true self-driving capability whenever that launches to consumer vehicles.
Tesla pitched FSD Lite as a way to bring the capability of Hardware 4 vehicles to Teslas with lower-performance hardware. But there have been snags. It’s not hard to search online and see complaints about FSD Lite. Complaints range from overheating FSD hardware to vehicles that aren’t tracking correctly in the lane.
Now, it’s a great thing that the driver who had the run-in with the downed tree was paying attention to the road and stopped in time. There’s a reason why it’s called Full Self-Driving (Supervised), folks. Pay attention to the road.

title: The Electric Land Rover Defender Just Got Delayed By Two Years: Report
content:
The Electric Land Rover Defender Just Got Delayed By Two Years: Report
The U.S. will get a version co-developed with Jeep's parent company, Stellantis.
- The next-generation Land Rover Defender won't arrive until the early 2030s, per a new report.
- JLR is delaying its rollout to see how the EV market evolves.
- The new Defender will ride on a dedicated BEV platform.
Jaguar Land Rover is delaying the next-generation Defender by two years amid rocky EV demand in its largest market, the U.S., and a steady decline in sales in China, according to The Times of London.
The iconic luxury off-roader is currently available only with combustion engines and is JLR’s best-selling vehicle. It was poised to enter the electric era with a major redesign, but that transition is now not expected to happen until the early 2030s.
The British luxury automaker is navigating a perfect storm across its major markets. The Trump administration’s tariffs on European car imports have squeezed its bottom line, while Chinese automakers continue to eat into its market share. JLR also suffered a costly Russian cyberattack this year that forced the automaker to shut down production for five weeks.
Land Rover Range Rover GT: Interior Reveal
Its global sales in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, which is the period from April through June 2026, fell 9.2% to 79,300 vehicles. The Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, and Defender accounted for 81% of those volumes, which shows just how important JLR’s three luxury SUVs are to its business.
Still, JLR is attempting to get back in the game with a string of new all-electric models in the pipeline. They include the Range Rover Electric, Range Rover Sport Electric, Range Rover GT and the Jaguar Type 01. The Range Rover Electric was first announced in October 2021 and was originally supposed to launch by 2024, but it too has been delayed by more than two years.
Now, because of the Trump administration’s tariffs—and the fact that the current Defender is built in Slovakia—the next-generation model will reportedly be offered in two versions: one tailored for Europe and another co-developed with Stellantis for the U.S., according to Automotive News.
The electric Defender will ride on JLR’s EV-native platform, the Electrified Modular Architecture (EMA), and a hybrid version is also expected to use the same architecture. The platform underpins the upcoming Range Rover GT, which we saw during a press trip to England in July. That means the new Defender could benefit from the advantages of an architecture designed specifically for EVs, including better packaging, more frequent software updates and an 800-volt electrical architecture.
Range Rover Sport Electric (Prototype)
The U.S. version would reportedly occupy a different segment from the current Defender. The Stellantis partnership could also help JLR reduce its tariff burden. The automaker currently faces a 10% duty on vehicles imported from the U.K. and a 15% duty on those imported from the European Union.
Exactly what Stellantis hardware JLR could use remains unclear. One possibility is a body-on-frame platform such as the architecture underpinning the Jeep Wrangler. Another is Stellantis’ STLA Large EV platform, which underpins the Jeep Recon.
Neither option has been confirmed, so for now, consider them possibilities rather than a preview of what’s actually coming. But all of this shows just how dramatically tariffs, rocky EV demand and Chinese competition are forcing even one of the world’s oldest and most iconic nameplates—the Defender—to rethink its future.

title: The Mercedes CLA 350 4Matic Destroys EPA-Rated Range With Shocking Efficiency
content:
The new Mercedes EV went close to 400 miles in a recent 70 mph range test.
Photo by:
Mack Hogan/InsideEVs
5:35pm ET
The Mercedes-Benz CLA is the company's smallest and lowest-priced EV in North America.
In a 70 mph range test, the four-door car blew way past its EPA-rated range of 312 miles.
It managed to eke out 4.44 miles per kilowatt-hour from its 85-kWh pack.
Mercedes-Benz's littlest EV is actually one of its most impressive. The new
2027 Mercedes CLA-Class
sedan absolutely crushed its EPA-rated range in Tom Moloughney's latest 70 mph highway range test by going 385 miles between fill-ups.
The CLA packs a decently big battery for being the smallest electric Merc on sale in North America: 85 kWh. But it isn't just the big battery that gives the Mercedes such an impressive range. It's also quite efficient. At the end of Moloughney's test for his State of Charge YouTube channel, he saw an average of 4.44 miles per kilowatt-hour. That's far beyond what it's supposed to be capable of.
According to the
, the all-wheel drive Mercedes CLA 350 4Matic has 312 miles of range, considerably less than the single-motor rear-wheel drive model's 374-mile range. Since Moloughney's test car was an all-wheel drive 4Matic model, it beat what the EPA says it can do by a whopping 73 miles—and did it all on the highway at 70 mph. Moloughney isn't alone, either, as
Car and Driver's
75 mph highway test saw 340 miles.
It wasn't like he did anything to give the Merc a boost, either, like messing with tire pressures or driving in especially good conditions. He filled the tires to Mercedes' recommendations and did the test in the summer on the New Jersey Turnpike. If anything, the Turnpike's horrific road surface, with its tire-destroying craters and loads of potholes patches, should be a detriment to an EV's range.
Photo by: Mack Hogan/InsideEVs
Also interesting is that the CLA's efficiency didn't really drop off as the battery depleted. For the first 95 miles, it was averaging 4.50 mi/kWh. For the next 100 miles, it actually improved to 4.52 mi/kWh. The next 95 miles were at 4.46, and then it finished the final 95 miles at 4.44. Mercedes poured a ton of effort into the CLA's efficiency, like using silicone carbide inverters and a two-speed gearbox. Fortunately for the Germans, that effort seems to have paid off. The CLA is a seriously efficient EV, up there with some of the most energy-sipping cars.
Lucid Air
has proven to get around 5.0 mi/kWh, and the Tesla Model 3 has managed 4.6 mi/kWh in
' testing. But the little Merc has is now among the most efficient EVs on the market and comes in at a relatively affordable price, with the 350 4Matic starting at $51,950. Considering the luxury and range you get, I'd say that's a pretty good value.

title: Wawa Branded EV Chargers Are Here Thanks To Electrify America
content:
This is what happens when a charging giant and a gas/sandwich giant team up.
Photo by:
Electrify America
12:58pm ET
Wawa-branded
EV chargers
are coming. As a South New Jersey resident, this is very exciting news. While there are already plenty of Wawas with EV chargers, the brands vary and it's kind of hit and miss, as they aren't always the kind of charger or speed you need. For example, the majority of Wawa charging stations near me are Tesla Superchargers, and only one of them allows non-Tesla vehicles. So while that's helpful, it isn't helpful for everyone. However, that's going to change in the coming years, as Wawa just partnered with
Electrify America
to put its own branded chargers at its gas stations.
This partnership is part of
Electrify America's White Label
program, that supplies third-party brands with an EV charging network that the brands customize. In this case, Wawa designs the look of the chargers, the experience, and even comes up with its own pricing. Electrify America builds the network and handles things like maintenance and customer support. So when you pull up to a Wawa charger, it will feel like its own thing, not just an EA charger at a Wawa, which is cool. Wawa also usually has the cheapest gas near me, so I'm hoping it carries its typical values onto EV juice. Also, Wawa, if you're listening, it'd be cool to see a price per kWh on the big digital gas signs.
Photo by: RivianTrackr
To start, eight Pennsylvania locations will get Wawa-branded chargers. Five of which will have have NACS and CCS ports with up 400 kW, while the other three will CCS-only and support up to 350 kW. The 400 kW locations in Upper Darby, Phoenixville, Media, Williamsport, and Reading will each have two chargers capable of juicing up two cars at a time. While the 350 kW Bristol, Allentown, and Quakertown spots will have four single-car charging stations.
At the moment, Wawa has 280 chargers across the 14 different states it operates in. Since Pennsylvania is its home turf, that's where these new chargers will go first, but it should start expanding outward in the coming years.
“This move to testing Wawa branded chargers demonstrates our ongoing commitment to meeting our customers’ fueling needs — whether they require electric charging or traditional liquid fuels," said Rich Makin, Wawa's senior vice president and chief fuel and development officer. By owning Wawa branded chargers, we are always striving to deliver a more seamless, reliable, and consistent experience and this allows us to provide more options throughout 14 states for our customers.”
I shouldn't be excited about anything that comes from the Philly area (eww Birds, go Giants), but I can't help but have love for Wawa. Every road trip must start with a Wawa run, with a few more coffee stops sprinkled in between, depending on how long the road trip is. Now, that'll be the case for more and more EV customers, too.

title: Xiaomi Unveils Custom Chip For Driver-Assist Features
content:
Xiaomi revealed new powerful in-house chips this week that will power everything from cell phones to electric cars.
Photo by:
4:37pm ET
Xiaomi has unveiled its first in-house chips dedicated to AI and self-driving.
The automaker currently relies on Nvidia for its hardware, though that could change as early as next year.
This makes Xiaomi the latest Chinese automaker to ditch U.S.-sourced chips in favor of self-produced silicon.
Xiaomi's next move in cars is happening somewhere you'll never see it: buried deep inside the dashboard, under a heatsink, doing the ungodly amount of math required advanced driver-assistance features.
On Monday, Xiaomi
unveiled
a family of in-house silicon, including the Xring D100 chip designed for "intelligent driving." This makes Xiaomi the latest EV maker investing in home-grown AI inference rather than relying on a market cornered by Nvidia.
Photo by: Xiaomi
Xiaomi's
EVs have historically relied on Nvidia's hardware, beginning with the older Drive Orin system and now the
Drive Thor
. That decision locked the Chinese brand in with the American GPU producer at a time when the entire world is looking at the same company for chips to power the insatiable appetite for AI.
Designing chips in-house comes with a few potential upsides. The D100 could be a buffer against soaring AI chip costs. It means
gets to tune its hardware to its own sensor, software, and driving models. It also means that Xiaomi gets more control over cost, supply, and development timing.
Other Chinese automakers like BYD, Nio, Xpeng have begun exploring in-house silicon development too. This is extremely important as key players in the U.S. AI arms race, like Anthropic's
Dario Amodei,
call for stricter export control of AI compute. Here in the States, Rivian recently announced a custom chip for advanced driving features that is debuting in the R2. Tesla has been designing its own chips to run Full Self-Driving (Supervised) for years.
Let's nerd out on the Xiaomi silicon's specs for a moment.
The D100 packs a 20-core CPU and a 16-core NPU. Xiaomi says that this is the first chip build in mainland China on a 3-nanometer chip production process (meaning it can potentially offer more efficiency and processing density in a single chip). It also supports up to 160 gigabytes of unified memory—enough to run up to a 200-billion-parameter model directly on the device.
For comparison, Nvidia's current Thor hardware is offered with a 14-core, 4-nanometer processor and up to 128GB of memory. Tesla's current Hardware 4 offers 16GB of memory on a single chip and is built on a 7nm process. Its upcoming Hardware 5 is targeting an even more efficient 2nm manufacturing process and is expected to feature up to 144GB of memory.
It's important to point out that it is possible for a system to offer more compute capacity but have lower overall performance due to optimization of overall efficiency. It's not clear if that's the case with Xiaomi's hardware compared to Nvidia or, say, Tesla, because Xiaomi has yet to reveal the system's actual Trillions of Operations Per Second (TOPS), which is a key measurement of speed and performance in AI inference.
Stay informed with our newsletter every weekday
Xiaomi says that it's poured more than $3 billion into the development of its new hardware. That might seem like an expensive way to avoid buying another company's chips, but Xiaomi's top brass clearly believe the independence outweighs the R&D costs.
That figure includes the Xring D100, as well as its O100 AI acceleration chip and O3 System-on-Chip (SoC) platform meant for mobile devices. The O3 is slated to debut in Xiaomi's upcoming 18 Fold cell phone, and the D100 and O100 are planned for commercial applications starting next year.

title: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 光线重建更新实测：提升游戏画面质感的“大杀器”
content:
今年 6 月，英伟达在 COMPUTEX 2026 展会上正式发布了 DLSS 4.5 光线重建技术，适用于全部的 GeForce RTX 显卡，该技术可以提升光线追踪、路径追踪场景的画面质量。本次发布的更新采用了第二代 Transformer AI 模型，新模型计算能力提升了 35%，可处理参数量增加 20%，降噪器更强大，空间感知能力更深入，同时性能表现与旧版模型基本持平。
新版 RR 模型将于 8 月末推出，屏幕前的各位玩家朋友们是不是已经迫不及待了。
最近提前体验了新的 F 预设 RR 模型，趁此机会给大家简单分享一下新模型在游戏中的实际表现究竟如何。
为了展现 DLSS 4.5 光线重建更新对于游戏体验的帮助，并贴合主流玩家硬件水平，本次测试我们统一使用以下硬件平台进行测试。
处理器我们选择的是 AMD 锐龙 7 9800X3D，显卡为 16GB GDDR7 显存的 GeForce RTX 5070 Ti；主板是来自七彩虹的 COLORFIRE B850M-MEOW WIFI7 V14，存储部分则是美商海盗船 DDR5 6000MHz C30 32GB*2 内存套条 + 三星 990 Pro 固态硬盘（1TB 和 4TB）。
系统方面，我们选择了最新的
Windows 11
25H2 版本，并进行了全新安装。
GeForce Game Ready 的驱动版本和大家一样，也是最新的 610.88 版本，不过体验新的 F 模型预设需要使用命令行工具额外导入，NVIDIA App 版本也更新至最新正式版。
由于这次更新的新模型，在性能表现上与旧模型几乎一致，因此我们的测试重点主要在游戏画面的对比上。
首先，大家需要在 NVIDIA App 中找到支持 DLSS 4.5 新 RR 模型的游戏，在 DLSS 优设-模型预设里从使用全局（默认）切换到自定义，然后在光线重建选项中找到并选择预设 F 模型，最后重新进入游戏，才能在游戏中生效。
本次测试，我们主要对比关闭光线重建、DLSS 4 光线重建以及 DLSS 4.5 光线重建的游戏画面，其中 DLSS 4 光线重建会选择全局默认模式或者老模型预设 D 进行测试。
1、《生化危机：安魂曲》
第一款游戏我们选择了 DLSS 4.5 光线重建新模型效果最为明显的《生化危机：安魂曲》，游戏本身在开启路径追踪选项下的画面差距就非常大，本次更新后，游戏在雨天积水效果、玻璃反射和物体细节清晰度上均有提升。
先说一下画面设置，游戏的画面分辨率选择 4K，光线追踪选项设置为开启 / 关闭路径追踪。
图形质量部分全部选择高档位，开启所有效果，纹理过滤质量设置为高（各向异性 x8）。
超分辨率质量部分选择 NVIDIA DLSS，超分辨率选择质量，帧生成选择 3 倍，Reflex 低延迟选择开启 + 增强。
光影质量部分选择全高设置，开启所有特效选项。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
游戏开头结束过场 CG 后，有一段女主前往调查地的线性探索场景，刚好是经典的雨天，无论是光影还是氛围感都直接拉满。
刚踏入这段旅程的开始，小编就注意到 RR 新模型 F 预设的一个重要提升。在不放大截图画面的情况下，关闭路径光追和开启路径光追的区别基本体现在暖光反射的还原上，左侧只开启光线追踪的画面完全是冷色调，连高处悬挂的明亮广告牌左侧墙体光照反射都可以忽略不计，而中间和右侧在开启路径追踪后，整体色调更暖，尤其是地面和墙上的光照反射都很明显。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
那么 DLSS 4.5 新模型的提升在哪儿呢？放大看这里的积水，关闭路径追踪时，积水效果很假，就像是还没有清理、已经被污染的碎冰渣一样，着实有点用力过猛。开启路径光追后，又迎来了一个新问题，路面积水大幅削弱，根本没有雨天的氛围，这个问题其实在 DLSS 4 老模型上非常普遍，小编在测试《007 初露锋芒》、《逆水寒手游》等游戏时就注意到，雨天水面的积水非常朦胧，只能看出是潮湿的地面，根本没有形成积水，雨滴落地的效果就像是硬生生在水泥地上泛起涟漪，然后直接渗入地下一样。
而在开启 DLSS 4.5 RR 新模型后，雨天积水效果真实了不少，雨水滴落在水洼的力度和涟漪效果更加拟真，积水洼不停被雨滴落下砸出的小水坑也非常还原，不过这部分毕竟属于动态物理效果，放大后的清晰度还有进步空间。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
第二个场景是街边的橱窗，仅开启光线追踪时前面的灯管亮度明显过曝，后面的橱窗玻璃完全没有光线反射效果，直接一片漆黑。而开启路径追踪后，橱窗玻璃的反射效果被正确还原，无论是广告文字牌还是焦点反射都非常真实，窗帘和右侧悬挂的小牌子也不再漆黑一片。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
进一步放大会发现，在 DLSS 4.5 新模型下前面灯柱的清晰度明显提升，反射在玻璃橱窗上的倒影也最明显，并且商店对面的红色广告牌反光也是最完整、最清晰。这就是 F 预设模型的第一个特性，提升反射效果和细节质量，让透明物体成像更加稳定，同时减少画面噪点。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
不只是透明玻璃的反射细节提升，有色玻璃的提升同样非常明显。在这组汽车玻璃的场景中，关闭路径追踪时画面整体发白，车身上的伪噪点最多，车窗玻璃反射的广告灯牌亮度最低、最暗淡，下方更小的物体反射基本看不清。
DLSS 4 老模型即便有路径追踪加持，表现依旧不够理想，整体光线和亮度做了修正，噪点数量明显减少，但车灯和上方车身的反射高光丢失了部分细节，整体发虚；广告灯牌的反射亮度正常了，但更小物体的反射积块挤成一团，反射轮廓反而不如关闭路径追踪下清楚。
RR 新模型 F 预设下的车窗玻璃反射比较清楚，已经能分辨出右侧车窗上的灯牌文字了，而左侧对于巷道顶部天空的反射也更加还原，能分辨出是什么场景。车窗和车身反射的高光细节也最丰富、最饱满。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
再看最后一组电话亭的对比，由于玻璃部分采用了做旧处理，因此反射效果是不如上面的透明玻璃和车窗玻璃的。
不过，三者的区别依旧不小，关闭路径追踪下电话亭玻璃几乎没有看到反光物体；开启路径追踪时还是能清楚看到对面摊子和背后卷闸门的倒影。其次就是电话亭的细节表现，出乎意料的是 DLSS 4 旧模型表现最差，整体的污渍划痕和顶部的铁锈细节最少、画面最糊，还有封印黄色胶条的褶皱纹理也最淡，甚至不如关闭路径追踪下的表现，算法缺陷比较明显；RR 新模型 F 预设整体细节最丰富，最清晰，也最锐利。
短短一分钟都不到的线性探索场景，就能看出这么多提升，RR 新模型对于物体反射的改进不可谓不大。
2、《识质存在》
《识质存在》作为一款科幻射击题材的游戏作品，玩家大部分时间都身处空间站室内环境，因此在光照效果的比重上，全局光照、激光效果、全息投影以及空间反射的部分更大。其中，全局光照和空间反射部分，DLSS 4 光线重建就已经有了不错的效果，这次 RR 新模型 F 预设的主要提升在于激光效果和全息投影上。
依旧交代一下游戏画面设置，分辨率选择 4K，开启光线追踪，开启 / 关闭路径追踪，DLSS 超分选择质量档，DLSS 插帧选择 3 倍帧生成。
画面特效部分基本为全高，网格质量选最高，Reflex 低延迟选择开启 + 增强。
关闭动态模糊、镜头光晕、镜头畸变、景深以及垂直同步等效果选项。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
先看这个常亮的激光幕束，关闭路径追踪时激光光束线条最平，动态小光条的闪烁最不明显，地面也完全没有激光反射倒影；DLSS 4 路径追踪下，动态小光条的呈现更加立体清晰，地面也有了不错的倒影表现，但是激光生成时并不是连续的直线，而是不停闪烁中间粗两边细的小光条连续闪烁变化，玩家肉眼感知到的动态变化就是线条粗细不均，闪烁速度和响应时间间隔长短。这方面 RR 新模型 F 预设的激光闪烁速度最快，响应时间最短，这点从倒影部分激光的“断线”程度就能看出来。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
对于非常亮、非固定位置的移动激光，区别则体现在激光光束消失时的过渡和残影回收表现。关闭路径追踪时激光直接瞬间消失，而且没有残影；DLSS 4 路径光追下，激光消失阶段会留下明显的残影，消失需要 1s-2s 的时间；而开启 RR 新模型 F 预设后，激光“消失”得更快，但没有完全消失，仔细看还是能在浅色背景处找到细微的残影痕迹。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
全息投影方面，主要提升的是探索过程中短暂出现的投影，比如这里的剧情小投影。在关闭路径追踪时，投影的粒子效果比较粗糙，人物更加“透明”，噪点比较密集；DLSS 4 路径追踪下，人物更有立体感，粒子噪点明显减少，但身上出现了如磨砂玻璃表面一般凹凸不平的纹理，并且褶皱边缘的毛刺较多；而 RR 新模型 F 预设下，全息投影的亮度和清晰度更扎实，衣服布料褶皱更自然、整体纹理更平滑、毛刺更少。不过负面效果也是有的，那就是手部的动态抖动更快更明显，因此截图中手部的变形最严重，不过在游戏中玩家接受的是连贯动态画面，因此视觉影响比较有限。
从《识质存在》游戏的表现来看，DLSS 4.5 光线重建的第二个特性也很实用，对于粒子和光线特效多的游戏，新模型进一步提升了特效的光照响应效果、动态细节真实性和模型精细度，对于类似《星球大战》系列、《地平线》系列这类光污染和特效多的游戏而言，今后的新作可以充分利用这些特性，将游戏的视觉效果带向新的高度。
3、《心灵杀手 2》
最后这款游戏《心灵杀手 2》的画面整体更偏写实，虽然题材是超自然现实和恐怖悬疑，但游戏中很多场景的建模细节和光照表现都很仿真。因此，复杂光照下的物体阴影和表现材质纹理，就成了 RR 新模型的提升重点。
照例先交代画面设置，显示部分的游戏分辨率选择 4K，开启 DLSS 均衡档和 DLSS 2X 帧生成，效果部分关闭动态模糊和镜头扭曲效果，仅保留胶片颗粒。
质量部分选择全高，并非高档位预设。
光线追踪部分选择极致档光线追踪，开启或关闭 DLSS 光线重建，其它选项一律选择极致。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪
在这个室内场景中，关闭路径追踪时的墙面颜色最白，台灯投影最浅；DLSS 4 路径追踪下墙面纹理最糊，女主衣服褶皱细节最少、印记最浅、卷马尾也有点虚影，不够清晰；RR 新模型 F 预设下，墙面纹理最清晰，台灯投影更真实，女主衣服褶皱细节最多，层次感最强，卷马尾线条更加锐利清楚。
左：DLSS 光线追踪-高；中：DLSS 4 光线重建 + 路径追踪；右：DLSS 4.5 第二代 Transformer 模型的光线重建 + 路径追踪

继续观察木柱反光和桌子前侧木头细节，也是 RR 新模型 F 预设的反光最自然，木柱纹理细节最多，桌子前侧木纹细节更丰富。

挪动视角至左侧吧台处，关闭路径追踪时吧台柜上的椅腿投影最浅、层次最平，且地板上出现了不自然的反射，看上去显脏，路径追踪下就没有这个问题。另外，女主身上背的猎枪也有虚影，不够清楚。DLSS 4 路径追踪下吧台柜的投影更立体但氛围感还是差了一点；RR 新模型 F 预设的吧台柜颜色和细节对比度更高、锐度更强，椅腿投影最立体，而且地板反光也更为柔和。
相比前两款游戏，《心灵杀手 2》的 RR 新模型提升感觉没有那么直观和具体，不过打开新模型后确实能感受出整体光照下，物体阴影和表面细节更加自然和真实。
今年IT之家实测了多款游戏的 NVIDIA DLSS 新技术升级，从 DLSS 4 性能翻倍的 4 倍帧生成，到 DLSS 4.5 突破上限的六倍动态多帧生成，再到全新升级的光线重建模型，英伟达始终以颠覆性的技术迭代，刷新着玩家既有显卡硬件的性能和画面表现，让老旧硬件持续解锁全新画质与帧率上限，年轻的新生代玩家“吃的是真好”，着实令人羡慕。
入局 AI 时代，英伟达的前瞻眼界，让其足够敏锐地抓住了机遇，将 DLSS 技术不断迭代，让用户手里的硬件不停焕发新的活力，持续“战未来”，不用频繁换新显卡，就能持续畅享极致流畅、高清沉浸式的游戏体验，感受最纯粹的游戏快乐。或许这就是 AI 赋能游戏技术的终极魅力：以持续的技术革新，让硬件不断重生，让热爱生生不息。

title: OpenAI 奥尔特曼承认自己高估 AI 普及速度：最大阻力其实是改变用户习惯
content:
IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，过去几年，全球科技巨头通过新品发布会、媒体采访和大量广告不断向公众灌输一个观点：AI 很快就会改变生活中的几乎一切。OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼却反其道而行之，主动去修正这种过于激进的预期。
奥尔特曼在 23 日公布的播客节目中承认，自己和其他 AI 支持者可能高估了 AI 普及的速度，要达到谷歌搜索或 iPhone 那样深入大众日常生活的程度，恐怕还需要更长时间。
奥尔特曼认为，最大的阻力之一其实来自人的习惯。绝大多数人已经非常习惯现有的技术和工作方式，很难迅速改用 Codex 这样的 AI 原生平台。即使新工具功能十分强大，企业投入再多营销费用，也很难让用户立即改变多年形成的使用习惯。
奥尔特曼坦言：“我觉得自己在几件事上判断错了。其中一点就是，经济本身的惯性实在太大。人们还是会继续做原来的事情…… 继续从同一家公司买东西，继续用原来的方式使用工具。从很多方面来说，我觉得这其实是好事，它会让我们面前这场巨大转型变得更平稳、更缓慢，我对此很感激。但这也意味着，我们所有人对时间表的判断都太激进了……”
IT之家获悉，奥尔特曼进一步指出，改变人的行为比科技圈的人想象中困难得多。他把 AI 的普及比作 Netflix 成立初期：当 Netflix 还只是邮寄 DVD 的公司时，人们依然照常去百视达租影片，并没有因为新模式出现就立刻改变习惯。
奥尔特曼同时承认，科技业至今没有成功让普通公众真正接受行业所设想的未来，即每个人身边都会有超级智能，而且足够安全的 AI 智能体提供帮助。“作为一个行业，我们并没有很好地向人们解释这些技术究竟有什么好处，以及其中的负面影响可以怎样减轻。”

title: OpenAI 秀肌肉，与博通共研的 Jalapeño 芯片将向英伟达 GB300 发起挑战
content:
感谢IT之家网友
8 月 25 日消息，OpenAI 今天（25 日）晚间在 Hot Chips 大会上公布了全新推理系统 Jalapeño 的更多细节，并首次披露基准测试成绩。在 SemiAnalysis 的 InferenceX 测试中，Jalapeño 无论是单用户 token 处理量，还是每千瓦吞吐量，都超过了目前市面上的顶尖推理处理器。
OpenAI 硬件负责人理查德 · 何在媒体电话会上表示：“测试结果最重要的一点，是 Jalapeño 相比目前最先进的产品实现了非常显著的性能提升。它可以
用相同的电力处理更多 AI 工作负载
，同时更快给出响应。Jalapeño 既适合高效服务大量用户，也能保持很低的延迟。”
Jalapeño 由 OpenAI 与博通共同开发，OpenAI 自有模型也参与了研发。OpenAI 希望把 Jalapeño 发展成一个能够延续多代的技术平台，使 AI 产品、模型、芯片和内存从一开始就协同设计。
这款芯片主要负责 AI 推理，也就是让已经训练好的 AI 模型真正运行起来，完成任务或驱动 AI 智能体。
OpenAI 使用 InferenceX 平台测试 Jalapeño 的推理性能，并与英伟达 GB200 和 GB300 超级芯片系统进行比较。OpenAI 称，在 GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek R1 和 Kimi K2.5 1T 三个模型上，Jalapeño 每瓦能够完成的 AI 工作量
是对比系统的 1.5 至 1.9 倍
，端到端延迟则约为对比系统的 28% 至 59%。
全栈协同开发也让 OpenAI 能够直接优化推理过程中最容易拖慢速度的环节。Jalapeño 重点降低
预填充和通信阶段的延迟
，而这两个环节在 OpenAI 看来往往是推理性能的主要瓶颈。
OpenAI 在公布测试结果的博客文章中提到，Jalapeño 从设计之初就尽量减少数据搬运和通信延迟。生成响应时使用的 KV 缓存等模型状态可以明确存放并保留在本地，系统再根据不同推理阶段，调配合适的计算、内存和网络资源。
据IT之家了解，OpenAI 计划在
今年年底前先“小规模”部署
Jalapeño，2027 年再逐步扩大部署量，但没有公布明年具体会投入多少芯片。
OpenAI 官方稿件：Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference

title: 上海发布 2026 版网约车行业自律公约：17 家平台集体签约，要求整治补贴冲单、低价倾销
content:
感谢IT之家网友
I'm OK 👌
8 月 25 日消息，据上海市交通委宣传展示中心官方公众号“上海交通”，上海市出租汽车暨汽车租赁行业协会网约车分会组织全市 17 家网约车承运平台企业，共同签署发布《上海市网络预约出租汽车行业自律公约（2026 版）》，规范网约车市场经营秩序，同时切实维护驾驶员和乘客合法权益，全面提升行业安全服务水平。
据IT之家了解，新版公约聚焦行业痛点，重点围绕人车资质全周期管控、运价抽成规范透明、营运数据精准报送三大核心内容，明确行业经营自律红线。
严守人车资质合规关口。公约要求各平台严格落实
人车双证核验准入机制
，严禁向无资质车辆、驾驶员提供注册及派单服务。动态排查存量运力，分批清退不合规对象，确保线上线下人车信息一致。建立驾驶员经营行为数据库，归集投诉、执法检查等多维度违规信息，对危险驾驶、拒载甩客等严重违规驾驶员纳入行业禁入名单，实现全平台闭环管理约束，守牢安全底线。
规范运价与抽成管理。要求平台
科学设置运价体系
，遵守抽成比例上限，整治补贴冲单、低价倾销等无序竞争行为。落实明码标价规定，公开计价规则、抽成比例及各类收费标准，统筹保障乘客出行权益与驾驶员劳动收益，维护公平的市场竞争环境。
压实营运数据报送责任。各签约平台须严格落实数字化治理主体责任，按照监管要求，实时、准确、完整报送营运相关数据。健全车辆、驾驶员、失信人员等工作台账，筑牢网络安全、数据安全及个人信息保护防线，以数字化赋能智慧监管。
参与签约的 17 家网约车平台表示，将严格恪守公约条款，主动履行社会责任，坚持合规经营、规范服务、暖心保障，提升出行服务品质，助力上海网约车行业高质量发展，服务城市综合交通出行保障。
下一步，行业协会将建立定期会商机制和年度履约检查制度，常态化开展督导检查，通过公约执行情况，督促履约不力平台企业限期整改，切实保障公约各项条款落地见效。

title: 小米汽车：澎程 N90 Max 智能电动门可实现开门杀预警及开门避障
content:
感谢IT之家网友
软媒新友2481472
软媒用户1238620
偏科骚黄4100只眼
Autumn_Dream
I'm OK 👌
8 月 25 日消息，小米汽车官方今日更新了答网友问（第 283 集），针对澎程 N90 Max 的智能电动门能不能防开门杀、澎程 N70 Max 后排成床时椅背承重能力如何、轨道桌板不用的时候收纳在什么地方等问题进行了集中解答。
IT之家附小米汽车本集答网友问重点内容如下：
小米澎程 N90 Max 的智能电动门能不能防开门杀？
可以的。N90 Max 的智能电动门，通过 9 颗摄像头、4 颗车门毫米波雷达、1 颗前向激光雷达融合感知，
可实现开门杀预警及开门避障
首先是开门杀预警，当乘客要开启电动门时，若此时车门的前向或后向刚好有车辆、电动自行车、自行车等快速靠近，车门会立刻预警并悬停。
同时从车内开门会提供一定的开门阻力
，以保护自身车辆和过往人员的安全。
其次是开门避障，当在狭窄区域开门或门外有障碍物或有人经过时，车门会主动避障并悬停，同时从车内开门的话会提供一定的开门阻力。若障碍物或行人短时间内又离开，车门又可继续开启，非常方便。
小米澎程 N70 Max 后排成床时，椅背向后放倒后是悬空的，那么椅背承重能力如何？
N70 Max 的后排成床，需要后排靠背向后放倒，然后在上面铺上床垫。但即使靠背下面悬空，您也不必担心承重问题。
N70 Max 的后排靠背整体向后放倒时，可均匀承受 200kg 承重
。而且我们即将推出的官方床垫也经历过多项严苛测试，比如充放气、气密性、爆破强度、耐高温性能等。其中在静态压力承载重量测试中，
常压环境下 24 小时之内，床垫均匀承重 200kg 也不会出现破裂、结构性损坏等
所以日常成床铺上床垫休息时，您大可不必担心椅背及床垫的承重问题。
轨道桌板，不用的时候收纳在什么地方？
小米澎程全系均可拓展轨道桌板
，以方便您临时办公、吃饭、娱乐等场景需求。
当您不需要使用轨道桌板时，
您可将整套桌板收纳到我们为您准备的收纳袋中
，然后整体放在后备厢即可。

IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，今天（25 日）晚间，苹果正式发布全新 Mac mini 便携式主机，搭载 M6 芯片的 Mac mini 价格为 6999 元起，教育版售价为 6199 元；搭载 M5 Pro 的 Mac mini 售价 12999 元起（15 核 CPU+16 核 GPU），教育版售价为 12199 元起。

据IT之家了解，苹果在 iPhone 17 Pro 与 iPhone 17 Pro Max 上加入了 Genlock 功能，让多台摄像设备支持极高精度的视频同步，方便实现多机位拍摄及虚拟制作。
Genlock（同步锁相）是用于多机位视频拍摄的同步技术，通过统一信号锁定所有摄像机的帧时间，实现精确对齐，避免画面不同步。

content:

IT之家 8 月 25 日消息，苹果今天悄然更新美式英语版妙控键盘，部分按键采用了重新设计的标识。
IT之家了解到，新款妙控键盘的 Tab、Caps Lock、Shift、Return 和 Delete 等键帽不再使用文字标识，而是改用⇥、⇪、⇧、↵、⌫等纯符号标识。
同时，带数字键盘的妙控键盘也将 Home、End、Page Down、Page Up 等键帽改成了纯符号标识。本次更新的产品有妙控键盘、带触控 ID 的妙控键盘，以及带触控 ID 和数字键盘的妙控键盘（白色、黑色）。
苹果唯一一款没有获得更新的美式英语键盘产品，是带数字键盘、没有触控 ID 的妙控键盘。

title: 苹果新款 Mac mini 可连接三台显示器，但不同处理器的多显示器最高分辨率有区别
content:
8 月 25 日消息，苹果现已推出新款 Mac mini，新品升级 M6/M5 Pro 芯片，售价 6999 元起，9 月 22 日上市。
据苹果官网所述，M6 Mac mini 可通过雷雳和 HDMI 端口连接三台显示器。
连接三台显示器时，
前两台显示器的最高分辨率可达 6K 60Hz 或 4K 165Hz
；通过雷雳端口连接第三台显示器时，初始分辨率最高达 5K 60Hz，通过 HDMI 端口时最高为 4K 60Hz。
M6 Mac mini 连接两台显示器时，第一台的初始分辨率最高可达 8K 60Hz、5K 120Hz 或 4K 240Hz；第二台显示器通过雷雳端口连接时，初始分辨率最高可达 5K 60Hz，通过 HDMI 端口时最高为 4K 60Hz。
M6 Mac mini 的雷雳端口支持菊花链，最多可通过单个接口连接两台显示器。
其雷雳 4 端口兼容原生 DisplayPort 1.4 传输速率
，支持 VRR 可变刷新率、HDR 和多声道音频。
M5 Pro Mac mini 可通过雷雳和 HDMI 端口的任意组合最多连接三台显示器。
连接三台显示器时，初始分辨率最高可达 6K 60Hz 或 4K 165Hz。
M5 Pro Mac mini 连接两台显示器时，第一台显示器的初始分辨率最高可达 8K 60Hz、5K 120Hz 或 4K 240Hz，第二台显示器初始分辨率可达 5K 120Hz 或 4K 200Hz。
IT之家注意到，M5 Pro Mac mini 最多可通过单个雷雳端口，连接三台显示器。
其雷雳 5 端口支持原生 DisplayPort 2.1 速率

title: Amprion's investments edge up to EUR 2bn in H1
content:
Amprion still expects an investment volume of EUR 7.4 billion (USD 8.6bn) for 2026 after spending EUR 2 billion in the first half of the year, up 4% year-over-year, the German transmission system operator said in its half-year 2026 report.
In the first half, EUR 1.19 billion of investments were made in the transmission grid operation segment and EUR 750.7 million in the offshore grid connections segment. The company completed 116 km of overhead line systems and 47 km of individual trenches for direct-current cable protection conduits.
Amprion made grid investments of EUR 5.4 billion in 2025. Earlier this year, it unveiled
plans to invest EUR 42.1 billion
in the expansion of the transmission network between 2026 and 2030.
The company said that from the end of 2026 it plans to complete one major project every year, referring to the energy corridors that will link Germany’s power generating northern part with the industrial centre in the west and south of the country. The Ultranet project is slated for compilation at the end of 2026.
In the first half of 2026, Amprion’s adjusted consolidated net profit increased 19% from a year ago to EUR 343 million, while revenues declined 11% to EUR 2.7 billion, mainly due to planned regulatory adjustments.
RWE recently
increased
its indirect stake in Amprion to 55%.
(EUR 1 = USD 1.167)

title: Australia launches 1.8-GW WEM call for renewable power generation
content:
Australia has fired the starting gun on a new tender under its flagship Capacity Investment Scheme (CIS), aiming to support 1.8 GW of renewable power generation capacity in Western Australia, within the Western Energy Market (WEM), the federal government said today.
CIS Tender 11 will be the first one requiring proponents to participate in the government’s Developer Rating Scheme (DRS), which was launched in March to create a framework that assesses and rates renewable energy developers and transmission companies to provide greater transparency among communities and landholders. Additionally, 180 MW of the overall sought generation capacity will be set aside for First Nations.
Registrations for participating in the WEM call are already open, with bids to be accepted between August 27 and October 22. The names of the successful projects will be announced in March 2027.
If all targets in the solicitation are met, tender 11 will likely be the final WEM tender under the CIS. The previous WEM generation round,
Tender 5
, awarded seven solar and wind projects to deliver 1,886 MW of power capacity, including 2,100 MWh of storage coming from a solar-storage hybrid park. All of them are set to support Western Australia as the state prepares to switch off coal by 2030.
“Western Australia has a critical role to play in Australia's clean energy future, and this tender will help bring forward the generation capacity needed to support the state's growing economy and population,” said Josh Wilson, Assistant Minister for Climate Change and Energy.

title: Avantus closes tax equity for Aratina 2 solar-storage project
content:
US utility-scale solar and storage company Avantus has closed a USD-300-million (EUR 257m) tax equity commitment for its Aratina 2 project in Kern County, California that combines 150 MW of solar generation with 452 MWh of battery storage.
The tax equity completes the financing package for the project, which is currently under construction and expected to go live by the end of 2026. Last month, Avantus secured more than USD 525 million in
construction financing
for the project. Aratina 2 is backed by a 15-year power purchase agreements (PPA) with Southern California Edison (SCE).
“Tax equity is the final piece of financing Aratina 2 needs to complete construction and enter our operating portfolio later this year,” said Michael Joh, Senior Vice President, Project Finance at Avantus.
Truist Bank provided the tax equity, marking the companies’ second tax equity deal
after Aratina 1
, which became operational
in July
.
Avantus intends to operate and maintain a controlling stake in Aratina 2, the second phase of the Aratina Solar Center. The two Aratina projects will have a combined 350 MW of solar capacity and 952 MWh of battery storage.
The company recently closed an
upsized USD-1.05-billion
corporate credit facility to support project execution across its core markets in California and the Desert Southwest.
(USD 1 = EUR 0.857)

title: Cadeler H1 profit declines on year-ago one-off fees
content:
Danish offshore wind installation company Cadeler A/S (OSL:CADLR) today reported net profit of EUR 88 million (USD 102.6m) for the first half of 2026, down from EUR 168 million a year ago, mainly due to one-off termination fees of EUR 111 million in the same period of 2025, as well as higher financial expenses.
Adjusting for the one-off termination fees, EBITDA and revenue more than doubled compared to the first half of 2025, to EUR 208 million and EUR 408 million, respectively.
The company said the increased results mainly reflect its fleet expansion and a higher number of contracted days. Fleet utilisation of its 10 vessels was 66%, relatively unchanged from 67% in the same period last year.
“These results demonstrate that our fleet strategy is delivering as intended, providing the flexibility, reliability and operational capabilities required to support the next phase of offshore wind development as customers place increasing emphasis on the resilience of their supply chains and certainty of delivery,” said CEO Mikkel Gleerup.
As part of efforts to strengthen its offering, Cadeler invested in increasing its foundation transport and installation capabilities in the period. A private placement in March enabled the order, after the reporting period, of two T-class newbuilds. The company is also planning an acquisition of a scour protection vessel, while in August it
acquired
German foundation installation specialist Menck.
Cadeler kept its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue of EUR 854 million-944 million and EBITDA of EUR 420 million-510 million. It added that the Menck acquisition is expected to impact the guidance, with this impact currently being assessed.
(EUR 1 = USD 1.166)

title: Canary Islands town to soon erect 3rd turbine at municipal wind farm
content:
Workers in the town of Galdar in Spain’s Canary Islands are pouring concrete foundation to install a 0.8-MW turbine for a project that will increase the capacity of an area municipal wind farm to 2.4 MW.
The Galdar city hall said on Friday that the installation of the third turbine at the Botija-Galdar wind farm was progressing well. Local officials visited the site to inspect works on the concrete foundation and said they expected the turbine to be fully installed in the coming weeks.
The municipality on the island of Gran Canaria is investing EUR 1.88 million (USD 2.19m) in the project, which will add a single Enercon E-53 wind turbine and connection infrastructure. Part of the costs are covered by a state subsidy of EUR 1.2 million granted by Spain’s central government and an additional EUR 684,598 grant from the Canary Islands’ regional ministry for the ecological transition and energy, the city hall said.
Years in the making, the wind farm expansion project
secured approval
from the regional authorities in April 2026. According to Galdar officials, the Botija-Galdar wind farm is the first fully municipal wind farm in the Canary Islands and at full 2.4 MW of capacity, its energy production will be equivalent to around 620.72 tonnes of oil per year.

title: Edisun Power inks EUR-470m binding deal to buy Smartenergy ops
content:
Swiss solar power producer Edisun Power Europe AG (SWX:ESUN) has entered into a binding agreement to acquire the business operations of its strategic partner, Smartenergy Group AG, in a deal worth just under CHF 440 million (USD 548.2m/EUR 469.9m).
The agreement was signed after Edisun shareholders
approved the transaction
at the company's annual general meeting in May. Edisun has conducted the majority of its business operations through Smartenergy Group for many years and said the transaction will consolidate the operations of both companies within the Edisun group.
Under the agreement, Smartenergy Group has granted Edisun a vendor loan equal to the purchase price and committed to subscribe for nearly 2.02 million newly issued Edisun shares. The companies plan to offset the vendor loan against the payment for the new shares as part of a capital increase expected in the coming days.
Following the transaction, Edisun will focus on renewable energy for data centres, synthetic aviation fuels (eSAF) and other Power-to-X applications, as well as solar and wind projects coupled with energy storage.
The enlarged company will change its name to Smartenergy and relocate its registered office to Wollerau by the end of 2026.
(CHF 1 = USD 1.246/EUR 1.068)

title: Fire affects turbine at Ørsted's Greater Changhua 4 off Taiwan
content:
A wind turbine at the Greater Changhua 4 offshore wind project in Taiwan has suffered a fire incident, Danish energy group Ørsted A/S (CPH:ORSTED) said on Friday.
The incident occurred on August 8. The turbine automatically tripped and stopped operation after its system detected an abnormal condition, following which the wind farm team observed and quickly extinguished a fire on the machine, the company said in a statement. No personnel were injured and relevant authorities and stakeholders have been notified, it added.
The turbine was immediately isolated from the transmission system and remains shut down, while the rest of the wind farm continues to operate normally.
Ørsted is investigating the cause of the incident in collaboration with the supplier, Siemens Gamesa. An investigation plan and a subsequent repair plan have been prepared.
Ørsted announced in January the
completion of turbine installation
at the 920-MW Greater Changhua 2b and 4 offshore wind farm duo. The Danish company owns Greater Changhua 4
together with
Cathay Life and Cathay PE.
In its second-quarter report, Ørsted said that the Greater Changhua 2b and 4 complex remained on track for commissioning in the third quarter of 2026. All Greater Changhua 4 turbines had been commissioned, and the export cable for Greater Changhua 2b was set to be completed in the coming period.

title: German wind energy body warns projects could lose bank financing
content:
The German Wind Energy Association (BWE) is pushing the federal government to guarantee the protection of existing wind projects amid signs that banks have begun to postpone or even fully withdraw financing for approved and awarded schemes.
The association blamed this development on the government’s “impractical plans” for the Renewable Energy Sources Act (EEG) and grid connection package, amendments to which were
submitted for consultation in July
.
"The federal government must immediately clarify that the protection of legitimate expectations remains in effect and that the planned limitation of active power output will not retroactively affect approved and awarded projects. Otherwise, there is a risk of significant financing risks and the loss of wind energy projects that are essential for achieving expansion targets and the future of our energy system,” warned BWE president Bärbel Heidebroek.
According to the BWE, Germany will imminently experience a dramatic collapse in wind energy expansion if the government does not take measures and revise its plans.
The approval process for onshore wind energy projects has significantly accelerated in the last few years following legislative amendments by the former federal government. In the first seven months of 2026, the green light was given to the installation of a total of 1,714 turbines with a combined capacity of 11.1 GW.

title: Hamburg starts building hydrogen connector for HH-WIN network
content:
German utility Hamburger Energienetze has started construction of the H2-Connector on the former Moorburg power plant site, a key hub for the planned Hamburg Hydrogen Industry Network (HH-WIN).
The facility will connect locally produced hydrogen, including output from the
Hamburg Green Hydrogen Hub
(HGHH) electrolyser, with the HH-WIN distribution network and Dutch gas grid operator Gasunie’s planned national hydrogen network, Hyperlink. It will include a hydrogen injection facility and a pressure regulation station, while a compressor station will be added later.
HH-WIN is due to start operating in the autumn of 2027 with an initial network length of 40 kilometres (24.8 mi), supplying industrial areas around the Port of Hamburg. The network is planned to expand to 60 kilometres by 2031.
The H2-Connector will allow hydrogen to flow in both directions between HH-WIN, operating at up to 25 bar, and Gasunie’s higher-pressure network, which operates at up to 70 bar. In its first phase, the facility will be capable of importing up to 360,000 normal cubic metres (12.7 million cu ft) of hydrogen per hour into Hamburg or exporting up to 200,000 normal cubic metres per hour.
Construction costs, excluding the planned compressor station, are estimated at around EUR 22.6 million (USD 26.3m), with about EUR 16.3 million covered by IPCEI funding.

title: India's Avaada plans USD-1bn green industrial campus in Haryana
content:
The government of Haryana state in India intends to facilitate the development by Avaada Group of a 300-acre Zero-CBAM Green Industrial Campus in Hisar with a proposed investment of INR 100 billion (USD 1.05bn/EUR 897m).
The clean energy conglomerate announced it has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Haryana Enterprises Promotion Centre (HEPC) under which the latter will provide support for the project, including by exploring a customised package of incentives and expediting requisite statutory approvals, among other activities.
The idea behind the project is to bring together renewable energy, industrial infrastructure and green manufacturing within an integrated ecosystem. The campus will help industries to decarbonise their operations, bolster energy security and get ready for evolving global carbon and sustainability requirements, including the European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM).
In addition, the partnership will help attract anchor investors, technology partners and industrial participants from overseas.
“We believe this initiative can attract global investments and technology, create over 5,000 employment opportunities and catalyse a new generation of green industrial development in Haryana,” commented Shri Vineet Mittal, Chairman, Avaada Group.
(INR 100 = USD 1.04/EUR 0.89)

title: Invenergy secures tax equity for 240-MW Ohio solar project with Crux
content:
Clean energy capital platform Crux said today it has closed a USD-215-million (EUR 184m) tax equity investment for Invenergy’s 240-MW Pleasant Prairie Solar Energy Center in Franklin County, Ohio
The project is currently under construction and is expected to begin commercial operations in 2027. The facility’s clean energy credits will be sold to a third-party offtaker.
The hybrid tax equity investment was made through a Crux-managed vehicle. The transaction was underwritten and structured by Crux's registered broker-dealer, Crux Capital Securities.
Crux said that tax equity remains a key financing tool for large-scale clean energy infrastructure as demand for reliable, affordable power continues to boom in the US. According to the announcement, developers are increasingly seeking integrated capital solutions that combine tax equity with transferable tax credits, debt capital and other financing products to improve project economics and speed up new power capacity delivery.
According to a
recent Crux report
, the US clean energy finance market has continued its momentum into 2026, with clean energy and manufacturing capex expected to reach USD 180 billion for full year and total tax credit monetisation to advance to USD 70 billion.

title: JR Kyushu signs solar power deal for bullet train line in Japan
content:
Kyushu Railway Company (TYO:9142), also known as JR Kyushu, has signed a contract that secures solar power supply for the Kyushu Shinkansen Kagoshima Route, a high-speed bullet train line in Japan.
Specifically, JR Kyushu has inked an off-site power purchase agreement (PPA) with local utility Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc (TYO:9508), Fuyo General Lease Co Ltd (TYO:8424), Enbio Holdings Co and CRE Co Ltd.
Under the terms of the deal, several solar power arrays totalling 8 MWdc will be installed on the roofs of logistics facilities developed and operated by CRE. Supply will start sequentially from August 2027. Once up and running, the solar systems will generate a total of 9.8 million kWh per year.
This is the first offsite PPA for JR Kyushu, the companies pointed out in a joint press release.

title: Masdar powers up 35-MW/70-MWh Rochdale BESS in UK
content:
UAE-based renewable energy company Masdar has started commercial operations at a 35-MW/70-MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) in Rochdale, northern England, its second such project in the UK, as it advances a planned GBP-1-billion (USD 1.36bn/EUR 1.17bn) investment in the country's storage sector.
The facility can provide enough electricity for about 35,000 homes per day based on two charging and discharging cycles, Masdar said on Monday. It can respond to changes in electricity supply and demand within milliseconds and will provide balancing services to the UK grid.
Masdar committed to developing a 3-GWh pipeline of battery storage projects in the UK following its
acquisition of Arlington Energy
in 2022. Since then, four projects advanced to the bankability stage and further.
The Rochdale facility follows the 20-MW/40-MWh Welkin Road battery in Stockport, which
began commercial operations
in December 2025.
Masdar is also developing battery projects in Chesterfield and Cardiff with combined capacity of 150 MW/300 MWh. Financing for the four projects was completed last month, with Masdar
securing up to GBP 97 million
from Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) and ING.

title: Naturgy gets green light to add 16.2 MW of solar to wind farm in Spain
content:
Spanish power and gas utility Naturgy Energy Group SA (BME:NTGY) has secured environmental approval to hybridise its Frescano wind farm in Spain’s Aragon region with a 16.2-MW/17.6-MWp solar farm, according to a resolution published in the region's official gazette.
Aragon’s environmental watchdog Inaga cleared the Frescano solar project, while imposing certain conditions and obligations to minimise the plant’s impact.
Set in the municipality of Frescano in Zaragoza province, the new solar farm is designed to feature over 31,200 modules mounted on trackers. Once in operation, it is expected to generate around 33,921 MWh of electricity annually, Inaga said in its decision to approve the solar-wind hybridisation.
The favourable environmental impact statement is valid for four years from the date of its publication in the regional gazette. Naturgy is also required to gather all other permits before launching construction, Inaga said.
The nearby Frescano wind farm
was commissioned in early 2020
. It has 24 MW of installed capacity, with seven wind turbines capable of generating around 80 GWh of electricity annually, Naturgy said at the time.

title: Norway gives Ventyr more time to apply for Sorlige Nordsjo II licence
content:
Ventyr, a partnership between JERA Nex bp and Ingka Investments, has been granted a 12-month extension by Norway’s energy ministry to submit a licence application for the Sorlige Nordsjo II offshore wind project.
The consortium
won the auction
to develop the 1.5-GW fixed-bottom wind farm in early 2024. Sorlige Nordsjo II is Norway’s first large-scale offshore wind initiative, expected to set the ground for a new industry in the country.
The energy ministry said on Friday that the new deadline has been set for October 15, 2027.
Ventyr applied for the extension in June. It said then it had slowed down certain project development activities due to unexpected challenges and the difficult macroeconomic environment in offshore wind. The requested additional time would, among other things, be used to assess a modified option for landfall and grid connection near Alcoa’s aluminium plant at Lista.
The ministry said it is granting the extension request due to the need to investigate the alternative connection route.
Norway has stated an ambition to allocate areas for 30 GW of offshore wind by 2040. However, its progress in developing the sector remains modest. In 2025, the government
gave up plans
to offer the Sorvest F area for fixed-bottom offshore wind development and said it would prioritise floating offshore wind.
Earlier in August, the Norwegian government said it
would be ready
with its quality assurance of the Utsira Nord floating wind support scheme in October, well ahead of the deadline set by the parliament, which mandated the review. This news was welcomed by the sector following the setback caused by parliament’s decision.

title: Otovo inks deals for USD-11m acquisition of Israel's Green Panel
content:
Norwegian-American energy services company Otovo SA (OSE:OTOVO) has signed two agreements in connection with its proposed USD-11-million (EUR 9.43m) acquisition of Israeli solar services provider Green Panel Solar Energy Systems Ltd, which is expected to expand its operations to 15 European markets and add an immediately profitable business.
Following
an acquisition letter of intent
in June this year, and
a private placement in July
to raise money for the deal, Otovo on Monday said it has signed two share purchase agreements to advance the takeover of the Tel Aviv-based business.
Otovo will first acquire Adma Holdings, which owns about 51% of Green Panel, followed by the acquisition of the remaining shares. The agreements were signed on Monday and are subject to conditions including a financial review.
The total purchase price of USD 11 million is subject to customary adjustments and will be paid through a combination of cash and new Otovo shares. About USD 6 million of the consideration is expected to be paid in shares issued at NOK 11.4596 (USD 1.23/EUR 1.05) each, based on the company's 30-day volume-weighted average price as of August 20.
The shares will be subject to a 12-month lock-up. The long-stop dates for completion are October 15, 2026, for the Adma transaction and March 15, 2027, for the Green Panel transaction.
The acquisition of Green Panel hinges on the completion of the Adma transaction.
“[…] in the event that the Green Panel Transaction does not close, the Adma Transaction will remain final and binding,” Otovo said.
The acquisition of Green Panel Otovo's eighth and largest to date. It is expected to add USD 12.8 million in revenue and USD 2.9 million in adjusted EBIT in 2026, the company said.
Green Panel provides field services, maintenance, replacement and logistics for residential and commercial solar, battery storage, electric vehicle charging and load-management systems. It operates a solar power command-and-control centre in Israel and has established operations in Hungary.
Otovo said the combined business would have what it considers Europe's largest dedicated behind-the-meter energy services footprint by country coverage. Its Endurance platform will manage field operations, warehouses and customer inventory across the enlarged network.
Otovo said the acquisition would also provide a platform for expansion across the broader Europe, Middle East and Africa region.

title: Ratch preps new investments for higher renewables revenues
content:
Thai power generation and infrastructure investor Ratch Group Public Company Ltd (RATCH:BKK) has set aside THB 10 billion (USD 304.9m/EUR 261.9m) to invest in new and existing projects this year, renewables included.
In its 2026 business plan, the company has earmarked the funds for initiatives in Thailand and Indonesia as it aims to make renewables account for at least 15% of its total revenue, it said on Monday. This year, it expects the commissioning of two new sites – a 71.05-MW solar park in the Philippines and a 5.5-MW hydropower plant in Vietnam – to start adding to its revenues.
In Thailand, Ratch is preparing to bid for community solar, utility-scale solar, wind, biomass and gas-fired power projects under its home country’s Power Development Plan. This will follow the signing of agreements to supply 128 MW of electricity to three data centre customers in Thailand.
Additionally, the company is evaluating opportunities in Indonesia, such as the expansion of a combined-cycle power plant in East Java and a combined-cycle power and cooling project in Batam. Talks are also in progress for a potential investment in a Turkish sustainable aviation fuel project with an annual production capacity of 100,000 tonnes.
“Our project pipeline has made satisfactory progress during the first six months of the year, while we continue to advance our greenhouse gas reduction roadmap towards achieving net-zero emissions,” noted CEO Nitus Voraphonpiput.

title: SENS partners with Etha on Finnish underground pumped storage project
content:
Sustainable Energy Solutions Sweden Holding AB (NGM:SENS) has signed a deal with Finnish green transition-focused consultancy Etha Oy to support the further development of an underground pumped hydro storage (UPHS) project in Pyhasalmi, Finland.
Under the agreement, Etha will provide project planning and management, technical planning and management, engineering support, coordination with suppliers and authorities, along with assistance in the permitting processes.
SENS’ UPHS project aims to repurpose infrastructure at one of Europe's deepest mines for large-scale energy storage. Water would be pumped to a higher underground reservoir when electricity is abundant and released through turbines to a lower level when power is needed.
The Pyhasalmi project had previously received conditional investment support from Finland's ministry of economic affairs and employment.
Earlier this year, SENS sold an
85-MW battery energy storage project
located in the same energy cluster.

title: Stargate Hydrogen appoints ex-Siemens executive as Finland director
content:
European electrolyser maker Stargate Hydrogen has appointed Petri Sarnes as country director for Finland as it seeks to expand its commercial presence in the Nordic country, which it describes as one of the most active emerging hydrogen markets on the continent.
Sarnes, who has more than four decades of experience in the energy sector, previously held several senior roles at Siemens, covering nuclear energy, oil and gas, power generation and renewable energy.
In his new role, Sarnes will lead Stargate Hydrogen's business and commercial activities in Finland and support customers developing and deploying green hydrogen projects.
The appointment comes as Stargate Hydrogen continues to build its presence in the Finnish market. Earlier this year, the company delivered a 1-MW alkaline electrolyser system to Fortum's
Kalla Test Center
in Loviisa.
Stargate Hydrogen develops alkaline electrolyser stacks for industrial green hydrogen production, targeting energy-intensive industries such as refining, ammonia, methanol, e-methane and steel production as they shift away from grey hydrogen. The company is headquartered in Estonia.

title: TPREL plugs in 190.5-MW solar FDRE plant in Rajasthan
content:
Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL) has commissioned a 190.5-MW solar farm in Rajasthan, India, as part of a larger 460-MW firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE) project that includes battery storage, its parent company said in a stock exchange filing on Monday.
The Kalasar solar farm in the Bikaner district has been developed under state-run SJVN's FDRE Tranche-1 and will supply electricity to Haryana Power Purchase Centre, Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company and Noida Power Company.
The project includes a 115-MWh battery energy storage system (BESS), as well as harmonic filter banks and static VAR generator systems, to support grid reliability and enable dispatchable renewable power, Tata Power Company said.
TPREL’s total utility-scale renewable capacity has reached 12.4 GW following the commissioning, of which about 6.9 GW is operational, including 5.6 GW of solar and 1.3 GW of wind. A further 5.5 GW is under development and is expected to be commissioned in phases over the next 24 months.
The Indian power company said its renewables subsidiary had completed the project's switchyard in three months and the harmonic filter bank in one month, despite compressed timelines and supply-chain disruptions affecting transmission materials, module mounting structures and other equipment.
Tata Power's total operational and under-construction power generation capacity exceeds 26 GW, including about 17.7 GW of clean energy capacity and 8.8 GW of thermal generation capacity, according to the filing.

content:

Details about the planned wind farm and the customer remain under wraps.

title: India Lifts Wheat Export Ban to Ease Global Supply
content:
India Lifts Wheat Export Ban to Ease Global Supply
Prioritise Us
on Google
Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has confirmed the lifting of the ban on wheat exports effective immediately (Image source: Getty Images/umesh negi)
India has lifted its three-year wheat export ban, easing pressure on global supply as Black Sea shipments face disruption
India has scrapped its years-long ban on wheat exports, a move that could ease global supplies at a time when Black Sea shipments are under renewed strain from escalating attacks between Russia and Ukraine.
The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) issued notifications on 24 August 2026 confirming the change took effect immediately. The revised policy covers wheat, the durum variety, flour, maida, semolina, wholemeal atta and resultant atta, all of which move from the prohibited to the free export category.
For senior supply chain leaders in food, agriculture and trade, the decision reopens one of the world's largest wheat producers to global buyers at a moment when established
supply routes are under pressure
India first banned wheat exports in May 2022, citing food security concerns and rising domestic prices linked to disruption from the
Russia-Ukraine war
. The restrictions were extended to wheat flour exports later that year.
“The export policy of Wheat flour and related products falling under the HS Code 11010000 is revised from 'Prohibited' to 'Free' with immediate effect.”
An official regulatory update from Lav Agarwal, Directorate General of Foreign Trade, Indian Government, 24 August 2026
The government eased the policy gradually rather than all at once. In February 2026, it allowed exports of 2.5 million tonnes of wheat and a further 500,000 tonnes of wheat products, citing improved stock availability. This month's decision removes the remaining restrictions entirely.
India's total food grain production reached an all-time high of 376.563 million tonnes in the 2025-26 season, up 5.3% on the previous year, according to government data released in May 2026. Wheat production alone rose to a record 120.657 million tonnes, an increase of 2.712 million tonnes on the prior season.
The US Department of Agriculture is forecasting India's domestic wheat
stockpiles
to end the 2026-27 season at a record level, pointing to a genuine surplus rather than a policy gamble.
India's domestic wheat stockpiles are predicted to end the 2026-27 season at a record level
Why the timing matters
The change lands as global wheat markets face fresh disruption from the Black Sea, the export corridor through which Russia and Ukraine, together among the world's largest wheat exporters, ship the bulk of their grain.
Benchmark Chicago wheat futures climbed more than 17% between the start of July and late August 2026, driven largely by a shortfall in Black Sea supplies. Escalating attacks on commercial vessels and ports in the region have pushed prices to a two-year high.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said over the weekend of 22-23 August 2026 that Russia had rejected a truce offer to end attacks on ships carrying agricultural commodities through the Black Sea.
For import-dependent buyers, the exposure is significant:
Egypt, the world's largest wheat importer, sourced more than 82% of its wheat imports from Russia and Ukraine in the first half of 2026
Indonesia, the second-largest importer, has contracted around 600,000 tonnes from alternative origins for July-September shipment
Algeria, Bangladesh, Jordan, Thailand, Tunisia and Vietnam also rely heavily on Black Sea wheat
Kpler analysis suggests prolonged disruption could push buyers toward strategic purchasing and a shift toward European wheat
India's surplus positions it as a credible alternative origin, alongside Bulgaria, Australia, Romania and Argentina.
What it means for supply chain leaders
A pickup in Indian wheat shipments could ease supply pressure across Asia, Africa and the Middle East, regions with the greatest exposure to Black Sea disruption.
It also reintroduces India as a variable in global grain
sourcing strategies
, three years after the country effectively withdrew from that role. Buyers who built supply chains around alternative origins during the ban may now find India competing for the same contracts as Bulgaria, Australia, Romania and Argentina.
The shift comes even as India itself has emerged as an importer of some other agricultural commodities, a reminder that the country's t
rade position
remains dynamic rather than fixed.

title: Supply Chain LIVE: Q&A With Priya Anand, Jabil
content:
Supply Chain LIVE: Q&A With Priya Anand, Jabil
Prioritise Us
